scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:dev && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:prod && wrangler deploy --env production && npm run tag:production
scripts.tag:production: node -e "const{execSync:x}=require('child_process');const t='production-'+new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g,'').slice(0,15);x('git tag -f production');x('git tag '+t);x('git push -f origin refs/tags/production refs/tags/'+t,{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.db:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env dev --remote
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
